payload.title: The gateway's sensor and ST-language bridges open new subscriptions on every NATS reconnect while the client restores the old ones itself, so after each reconnect every sensor reading, edge I/O, alarm and automation event is broadcast once more to WebSocket clients
evidence: apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/nats-bridge.service.ts:340 (subscribes again to readings, edge I/O and alarms without unsubscribing the existing subscriptions, whose iterators keep running)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/st-language-bridge.service.ts:252 (drops the references to the existing subscriptions without unsubscribing them)
payload.rule_violated: One published event reaches each WebSocket client once; a subscription is made once and the NATS client carries it across reconnects
payload.notes: @nats-io/nats-core 3.4 resends every live subscription after each (re)connect (ProtocolHandler.sendSubscriptions, called when the connection is established), so a subscription never ends on a reconnect. The farm and messaging bridges unsubscribe before subscribing again, which is correct but redundant.
